name: Mean Reversion - Bond Universe + 8% Vol Target
description: Applies short-term contrarian strategy (20-day trailing-return reversal, inverse volatility weighting) to the fixed-income universe (US Treasuries, USD-hedged global aggregate, global high yield, EUR govt bonds, India INR govt bonds), capturing mean-reversion opportunities across the bond sleeve, then scales to 8% annualised volatility target. Tests mean-reversion mechanics within fixed-income markets.
